tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.description: Live snapshot of a crypto pair on liquidmap: price, 24 h change, the largest resting bid and ask walls near the price, big aggressive trades ("bursts") of the last hour, today's CVD (spot and perpetual) and futures funding and open interest. Start here.

tools.name: order_book_walls
tools.description: Large resting limit orders ("walls") in the order book within ±range_pct of the price, sorted by size in USD. source "binance" = Binance spot book; "all" = 15 books from 10 exchanges aggregated (Binance, OKX, Bybit, Kraken, Bitfinex, Coinbase, Bitstamp, Gemini, Deribit, Gate).

tools.name: big_trades
tools.description: Big aggressive market orders ("bursts": trades of the same side grouped in 5-second windows) of the last N minutes, with side (buy/sell), size, USD value, price and verdict (absorbed = the resting book took it and price did not go through; broke_through = it moved price), plus the share of absorbed

tools.name: candles
tools.description: OHLC candles with aggressive buy and sell volume, delta and point of control (POC). With footprint=true, each candle also has its price levels with bought and sold volume (at most 20 candles).

tools.name: cvd
tools.description: Cumulative volume delta (aggressive buys minus sells) for spot and the USDT perpetual, as in the liquidmap terminal: reset every day at 00:00 Madrid time up to 1h, every week (4h), month (1d) or year (1w).

tools.name: futures
tools.description: USDT perpetual of the pair on Binance: funding rate and next funding time, mark price, open interest (last 24 h, hourly) and liquidations of the last 24 h summarised: longs and shorts liquidated in USD, the price zones with most liquidations and the 10 largest.
